mutant.description: Successor check as a mutant on a dormancy verdict: age alone cannot distinguish dormant-because-ABANDONED from dormant-because-KEY-MIGRATED, and the two take opposite actions (Rule 25). Tested whether the ~229d json/valuations/ pair had a live successor rather than concluding abandonment from age.
mutant.expected: If the timestamps discriminate, a key known to have published this morning carries a fresh stamp while the suspected-dormant twin does not.
mutant.observed: POSITIVE CONTROL: json/benchmarks/model_portfolio_benchmarks.json (published by this morning's 07:00 run, content-verified in its own log) carries 2026-08-12 07:06:03 -- identical stamp to json/valuation/{risk_premium_data,valuation_data}.json. The twin json/valuations/{risk-premium,valuation-data}.json carries 2025-12-26 13:56. The timestamps discriminate and are not a listing artifact, so the verdict is KEY-MIGRATED with a live successor one prefix over, NOT abandoned.
